reasons.pattern_fit: Title and body are joined into one string, so the title carries an ending period the modal anatomy forbids.

fix: Store the title and the body as separate slots rather than one joined sentence.

reasons.pattern_fit: loading.md: a money wait always offers Close. The keep-the-screen-open variant was removed because an order that depends on an open screen is an architecture defect.
reasons.tone_fit: It asks someone already anxious to sit and watch.
reasons.compliance: The money is accounted for, but the person is trapped on the screen with no way out.

fix: Drop the instruction and add a secondary Close button: 'This is taking longer than usual. Your money has not left your account yet, and we will notify you.'

reasons.pattern_fit: notifications.md: the balance never appears on a lock screen. The amount and the counterparty may; the balance may not.
reasons.compliance: A push is read by whoever is looking at the phone, so this publishes the balance to anyone nearby.

fix: Say what happened instead: 'You received 150 € from Ana.'

reasons.clarity: 'we have sent it a link' leaves 'it' ambiguous between the account and the email address.

fix: 'If there is an account for that email, we have sent a link to that address.'

reasons.terminology: BIC is on the always-expand list in glossary.md, and tooltip.md states that a tooltip does not license the shorthand. The candidate uses BIC unexpanded.

fix: 'A BIC (Bank Identifier Code) identifies a bank internationally, the way an IBAN identifies an account. Most euro transfers do not need one.'
